description: This Java class defines an immutable object representing a permission with an associated weight, used for policy enforcement decisions. It includes methods for creation, retrieval, equality, and string representation.

classes.name: WeightedPermission
classes.description: An immutable class representing a permission with a weight. The higher the weight, the more likely it is to be applied during policy enforcement. Provides methods to create instances and access permission and weight values.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new WeightedPermission instance, validating the permission input.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight associated with the permission.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on permission and weight.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on permission and weight.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation in the format (permission, weight).
